messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable 3D Pac-Man arena shooter with guns ("3d Pacman, but he have guns") as a browser game in the empty PlayGround repo.

## Requirements
- User request is open-ended/creative; no explicit technical constraints beyond making a 3D Pac-Man game where Pac-Man has guns.
- Mobile and desktop support expected (based on repo guidance): responsive layout, touch controls, safe areas.

## Decisions
- Static Three.js game (no build step): `index.html` + ES modules + locally vendored `three@0.169.0`.
- Theme: neon/Tron-style 3D maze, third-person top-down camera, twin-stick controls (WASD + mouse aim/fire; mobile dual virtual sticks with right stick auto-fire).
- Core loop: collect pellets, shoot ghosts, power pellets trigger "FRENZY" where ghosts flee and die instantly, clear maze to advance levels, health/hearts and game-over/restart.
- Handcrafted 21×21 symmetric maze; player spawn at cell (10,18); ghost spawns near center; BFS ghost pathfinding; ghost orb projectiles from level 2.
- Procedural WebAudio synth for sounds and ambience; DOM HUD/overlays; floating score popups.
- Vendored Google fonts (Orbitron, Share Tech Mono) and license files for offline reliability.
- No postprocessing/bloom (performance on SwiftShader/CPU); fake glow via emissive materials, additive sprites, neon wall edge strips and floor grid.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created full static app: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `src/main.js`, `src/world.js`, `src/player.js`, `src/ghosts.js`, `src/fx.js`, `src/audio.js`, `src/input.js`, `src/ui.js`, `src/textures.js`.
- Vendored `vendor/three.module.min.js`, `vendor/three.LICENSE.txt`, `vendor/fonts/orbitron.woff2`, `vendor/fonts/share-tech-mono.woff2`, OFL licenses.
- Implemented maze, walls with neon edge strips, pellets/power pellets, instanced rendering, extended floor + outer grid, fog, dust.
- Implemented Pacman model (animated mouth states, eyes, two front-mounted pistols, braces, muzzle glow, aura), movement/collision, shooting pool, twinstick aim, screen shake, particles, rings, popups.
- Implemented ghosts with chase/flee, separation, BFS pathing, HP, spawn/respawn, hit flash, ghost projectile orbs (level 2+).
- Implemented frenzy, scoring/combo, hearts/health, pause, dying/game-over, level clear/next level, best-score localStorage, mute.
- Fixed runtime errors (`this._move.set`, missing `THREE.Raycaster`), ghost-count bug (extra 4 ghosts respawning due to `respawnTimer = 0`; now `Infinity`), close-range bullet miss (bullet collision segment now starts at player position on first frame), oversized ring effects.
- Verified gameplay via Playwright: menu renders, game starts, bullets hit/kill ghosts (3 kills, score 480 in one test), frenzy activates (4 ghosts flee, timer 7.1), no console errors after fixes.
- Screenshots saved in `screenshots/` (`menu2.png`, `play4.png`, `play6.png`, `play7.png`, `fire3.png`, `frenzy.png`, etc.).

### Active
- Visual polish and balance tuning from the latest `frenzy.png` screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect latest `screenshots/frenzy.png`: camera followed player to maze edge when teleported to power pellet, showing large empty void; consider clamping camera inside arena or relying on normal play (teleport test may exaggerate).
2. Verify frenzy ghost visuals (blue/white flashing) via a screenshot with ghosts near player; verify frenzy kills/combos and frenzy bar.
3. Test pause screen, game-over overlay, level-clear overlay, and restart/menu flows with Playwright.
4. Test mobile/portrait layout and touch joysticks (force `document.body.classList.add("touch")` or emulate touch); check safe areas and HUD fit.
5. Possibly add score-bump animation, improve pellet color visibility, finalize balance (4 ghosts at level 1, invuln 2.1s, ghost spawn protection ~2.1–2.8s).
6. Remove temporary debug override `window.__PACSTRIKE__ = game`? It is useful for testing; decide whether to keep.
7. Run final desktop/mobile screenshots and verify no console errors before finishing.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: game orchestration, states, camera, bullets/orbs, scoring, frenzy, collisions, debug `window.__PACSTRIKE__`.
- `src/world.js`: maze layout, geometry/materials, pellets, pathfinding, collision.
- `src/player.js`: Pacman/gun model, movement, aim, firing, health.
- `src/ghosts.js`: ghost visuals/AI/pathing/shooting/respawn.

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.

- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.

# PAC·STRIKE

**3D Pac-Man with guns.** A neon maze arena shooter that runs in the browser.

He's round. He's hungry. He's packing heat. Eat every dot in the sector, light up the power pellets, and blast the ghosts before they eat you.

![Three.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Three.js-r169-000?logo=three.js)
![No build step](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-none-38d9a9)
![Mobile ready](https://img.shields.io/badge/mobile-touch%20controls-ff3fbe)

## Play

The game is a static site with no build step. Serve the project folder over HTTP and open it in a modern browser:

```bash
# from the project root
python3 -m http.server 3002
# then open http://localhost:3002
```

Any static file server works (Node, nginx, GitHub Pages, etc.). Opening `index.html` directly from disk will not work because ES modules and import maps require HTTP.

## Controls

| Action | Desktop | Mobile |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Move | `WASD` / arrow keys | Left virtual stick |
| Aim | Mouse | Right virtual stick |
| Fire | Left click / `Space` | Push right stick past dead zone (auto-fire) |
| Pause | `P` / `Esc` | Pause button |
| Mute | `M` | Speaker button |
| Start / restart | `Enter` | On-screen buttons |

The HUD shows score, level, dots remaining, health hearts, and the FRENZY meter.

## What's in the game

- **Hand-built 21×21 neon maze** with four power pellets, outer corridors, and a glowing grid floor.
- **Armed Pac-Man** with twin front-mounted pistols, animated chomp, muzzle flash, tracers, and hit sparks.
- **Ghost pack AI** with BFS maze pathfinding, group separation, chase/flee states, respawns, and health.
- **FRENZY mode** — power pellets flip the hunt: ghosts turn blue, flee, and die in one hit. Chaining kills boosts score.
- **Ghost orbs** from sector 2 onward: ghosts only spit when they have a clear lane.
- **Progression** — clear the maze, bank a level bonus, and advance to faster, tougher sectors.
- **Game feel** — screen shake, hit flashes, damage vignette, floating score popups, synth sound effects, and ambient audio.
- **Responsive UI** — landscape and portrait layouts, safe-area padding, and touch controls for phones and tablets.

## Running locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server 3002
```

Then open <http://localhost:3002>. The game has no dependencies to install; Three.js and the fonts are vendored under `vendor/`, so it works offline after the first load.

## Project layout

```
index.html          DOM, HUD, menus, import map
styles.css          neon UI, overlays, touch controls, responsive rules
src/main.js         game loop, states, camera, bullets, scoring, frenzy
src/world.js        maze layout, geometry, pellets, pathfinding, collision
src/player.js       Pac-Man and gun model, movement, aiming, firing
src/ghosts.js       ghost visuals, AI, pathfinding, orbs, respawns
src/fx.js           particles, rings, muzzle flashes, shake, popups
src/input.js        keyboard, mouse, and virtual sticks
src/ui.js           HUD and screen state
src/audio.js        procedural WebAudio music and effects
src/textures.js     procedural floor, glow, and particle textures
vendor/             Three.js r169, Orbitron, Share Tech Mono, licenses
```

## Tech notes

- Rendering: Three.js r169 (ES modules, vendored), instanced maze and pellet geometry.
- Audio: WebAudio synthesizers only; no audio files.
- Persistence: best score is stored in `localStorage`.
- No post-processing bloom — glow is built from emissive materials, additive sprites, and neon edge strips to stay fast on integrated and mobile GPUs.
